title: In-silico and In-vivo Investigations Reveal Ameliorative Potential of Myricetin Against Doxorubicin-induced Myocardial Damage via Modulation of NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Barote, Purvaj G; Pawar, Harshal D; Sayyed, Mudassar; Awathale, Sanjay N; Nakhate, Kartik T; Rathod, Sumit S; Sherikar, Abdulla K; Harle, Uday; Suchal, Kapil; Goyal, Sameer N
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和动物实验研究杨梅素对多柔比星心肌损伤的保护作用，核心是NF-κB信号通路而非TF-DNA互作，方法仅简单对接且无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Although Doxorubicin (DOX) is an effective anticancer agent, its cardiotoxicity limits clinical use. DOX-induced oxidative stress augments NF-kappaB expression, elevates inflammatory cytokines, and causes myocardial injury. Since the flavonoid Myricetin (MYR) has antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and NF-kappaB-inhibitory properties, we investigated its potential to mitigate DOX-induced cardiotoxicity in rats. METHODS: Molecular docking of MYR was performed against NF-kappaB and proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6). After confirming binding affinities, DOX was administered to rats on days 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9, while MYR was given daily for 9 days. On day 10, hemodynamic parameters were recorded, and blood and heart tissues were collected. Serum transaminases (SGPT, SGOT) and cardiac markers (CK-MB, LDH) were measured. Oxidative stress markers (CAT, SOD, GSH, MDA), proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6), NO, NF-kappaB levels, and myocardial histopathology were assessed. RESULTS: MYR exhibited strong binding affinity to target proteins. In vivo, MYR significantly attenuated DOX-induced ECG (ST height) alterations and reduced serum SGPT, SGOT, CK-MB, and LDH levels. In cardiac tissue, MYR enhanced CAT, SOD, and GSH, while reducing MDA. MYR also decreased NF-kappaB, NO, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 levels, and improved histopathological features. DISCUSSION: These findings suggest that MYR effectively counteracts DOX-induced myocardial injury by suppressing NF-kappaB-mediated inflammatory pathways and oxidative stress, supporting its therapeutic potential in cardioprotection. CONCLUSION: MYR mitigates DOX-induced cardiotoxicity through antioxidant and antiinflammatory mechanisms involving inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling.
abstract_zh: 引言：尽管阿霉素（Doxorubicin, DOX）是一种有效的抗癌药物，但其心脏毒性限制了临床应用。DOX诱导的氧化应激增强NF-kappaB表达，升高炎症细胞因子，并导致心肌损伤。鉴于黄酮类化合物杨梅素（Myricetin, MYR）具有抗氧化、抗炎及NF-kappaB抑制特性，我们研究其减轻大鼠DOX诱导心脏毒性的潜力。方法：对MYR与NF-kappaB及促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6）进行分子对接（molecular docking）。在确认结合亲和力后，于第1、3、5、7、9天给予大鼠DOX，同时每日给予MYR，持续9天。第10天记录血流动力学参数，并收集血液和心脏组织。测定血清转氨酶（SGPT、SGOT）和心脏标志物（CK-MB、LDH）。评估氧化应激标志物（CAT、SOD、GSH、MDA）、促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6）、NO、NF-kappaB水平及心肌组织病理学。结果：MYR对靶蛋白表现出强结合亲和力。在体内，MYR显著减轻DOX诱导的心电图（ST段高度）改变，并降低血清SGPT、SGOT、CK-MB和LDH水平。在心脏组织中，MYR增强CAT、SOD和GSH，同时降低MDA。MYR还降低NF-kappaB、NO、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6水平，并改善组织病理学特征。讨论：这些发现表明，MYR通过抑制NF-kappaB介导的炎症通路和氧化应激，有效对抗DOX诱导的心肌损伤，支持其在心脏保护中的治疗潜力。结论：MYR通过涉及抑制NF-kappaB信号传导的抗氧化和抗炎机制，减轻DOX诱导的心脏毒性。
